dominant_strengths: Confident dark palette with crimson accent diagonals creates a focused, premium product mood consistent with Raycast brand language.
Floating glass nav with clear hierarchy and pill CTA reads cleanly against the deep background, anchoring the page well.
AI section divider with thin red rule and centered label is a small but tasteful editorial flourish.
dominant_weaknesses: Mid-scroll state is awkward: overlapping headline fragments at top suggest a broken sticky/transition rather than intentional layering.
Massive vertical whitespace between the Compare Plans block and the AI section starves the composition of rhythm and density.
Hero device mock crops oddly at the fold and the prompt 'How do I quit Vim?' is a tired meme that undermines a Pro pitch.
fix_priorities: Resolve the overlapping/clipped headline at the top — fix sticky transition or add proper masking so scroll states feel intentional.
Tighten vertical spacing between sections and introduce supporting micro-content to avoid empty mid-scroll dead zones.
Replace the placeholder AI prompt with a credible, brand-aligned demonstration of Pro capability.
Add subtle scroll-linked motion (parallax on the red diagonals or device) to reward continued scrolling.
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral impression is strong via color and gloss, but behavioral clarity falters at this scroll position and reflective payoff is diluted by a clichéd demo query.
rationale.intent_fit: It communicates a Raycast Pro AI feature page mid-scroll, but the transition state feels unresolved rather than a polished narrative beat.
